name: Celestial Glass Garden
description: An otherworldly garden where every flower is sculpted from translucent glass, glowing with captured starlight.
prompt: A surreal night garden filled with delicate glass flowers of various shapes — roses, lilies, orchids — each emitting a soft inner glow like captured stars. The ground is mirrored black stone reflecting the luminous blooms. Fireflies made of pure light drift among them. Photorealistic, macro details, subtle depth of field, cool color palette with warm highlights.
caption: Blooms that never wilt, only shimmer ✨🌸 #GlassGarden
